name: px-pos
description: PostX POS: pos-admin (Next.js) + pos-app (Expo) on one Firebase backend

scripts.rules:test: JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21 PATH=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/bin:$PATH npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 emulators:exec --config firebase/firebase.json --only firestore --project demo-px-pos "vitest run --root firebase/test"
scripts.rules:deploy: npx -y firebase-tools@15.29.0 deploy --config firebase/firebase.json --only firestore:rules,firestore:indexes --account adxbypostx@gmail.com --project postx-pos --non-interactive
